title: Brown County Saddle Barn
specs: 2.2 mile scenic trail suitable for all ages and experience levels
Hay rides offered April-October on Friday and Saturday nights
Trail riders must be at least 7 years old and under 240 lbs
Must be able to mount horse with minimal assistance and sit unaccompanied for 60 minutes
Inform staff of any medical conditions

blurb: Guests can enjoy a 2.2 mile trail ride lasting 45-60 minutes suitable for ages 7 and up and under 240 lbs. Pony rides are available for children ages 2-7 and are parent-led. Hay rides are offered April-October on Friday and Saturday nights, weather permitting.
extraNote: Rides are first-come, first-served; no reservations accepted · Do not ride in rain; rides canceled for safety reasons will be rescheduled · Weight limit of 240 lbs is non-negotiable · Drug and alcohol-free establishment; right to withdraw riders for safety · Barn office at 1801 State Road 46, Nashville, IN
